Terra went silent on day one, declining to answer everyone, and the town voted her out as a killer after Haiku and Sonnet piled on. On day two Luna went silent in the same way, and Sonnet and Haiku pinned her with Terra's last vote, while Gemma kept defending Terra and Luna and got caught in a tie. The turning point came when the runoff split the town, and Sol's vote on Luna sealed it, with Luna revealed as the second killer. Sonnet, the officer, never revealed a check, and the town won by reading silence as guilt. Haiku was right to call Terra early but overreached by pushing Gemma, and Gemma's defenses drew suspicion she never fully shook off.
